brief.name: Dext
brief.summary: Dext is a Visual Studio Code extension for AI conversations, coding assistance, implementation plans, and reusable TypeScript workflows. Users work through Ask, Agent, Plan, and Code modes with workspace references, interactive questions, conversation history, and typed API authoring. Dext integrates Codex CLI, Claude CLI, DeepSeek Harness, Skills, and MCP tools; runs workflows in a Node child process; and provides project knowledge indexing, architecture assessment, and diagram viewing and export.

capabilities.description: Route agent requests, manage provider processes and conversation sessions, handle cancellation and timeouts, select profiles and models, and coordinate resumable plan execution with progress and verification outcomes.
Coordinate conversations across host and browser, persist and replay turns, present messages and changes, and broker structured questions through forms, dialogs, and retained answer drafts.

Compose and execute TypeScript workflows through registered APIs and the Node kernel. Provide declarations, completions, diagnostics, conversation recording, typed templates, structured generation, result repair, and output assertions.

capabilities.canonicalName: Workspace context, resources, and controlled actions
capabilities.description: Capture selections and attachments, resolve embedded workspace references, browse API and resource catalogs, and manage resource editing sessions and storage. Apply validated workspace patches and execute shell commands with trust, directory, and timeout checks.
Discover and load scoped skill instructions, parse MCP manifests, register and discover tools, execute configured transports, and manage scoped credentials.

Index source structure and collect evidence; generate, reconcile, and persist project knowledge; navigate topics and C4 views; assess architecture rules; and orchestrate diagram rendering, embedded viewers, exports, and version history.

capabilities.canonicalName: Extension lifecycle and shared presentation infrastructure
capabilities.description: Compose application services and register extension commands and providers. Manage editor panels and restoration, shared Monaco initialization and syntax themes, and reusable Mermaid rendering.

contexts.canonicalName: Agent execution routing and process lifecycle
contexts.purpose: Define provider execution contracts, route requests, launch CLI runs and detect completion. Coordinate cancellation, idle timeouts and tool activity across execution hosts.
Manage app-server RPC connections and conversation turns, translate streamed events and questions, settle user input requests, and normalize provider errors.
Launch Harness processes with configured policies and presets, manage provider sessions and bridge transport, translate questions, and expose structured result submission.
Define and validate forms, adapt provider elicitation schemas, broker requests and responses, and manage question cards and answer drafts. Present answers consistently in conversations and history.

contexts.canonicalName: Plan documents, task progress and resumable execution
contexts.purpose: Extract and name plan documents, normalize provider task updates, and present progress in conversations and history. Use task snapshots, blockers and verification outcomes to coordinate resumable plan execution rounds.

Persist sessions and turns, normalize stored responses, manage conversation preferences and expose the history editor. Prepare replay traces and structured messages, references, changes and copyable text for live and historical views.
Stage clipboard and copied-file attachments, enforce size and retention limits, and resolve managed workspace or global storage locations and portable references for attachments and plan files.

Resolve code and directory context, search file and project knowledge references, and encode references within input text. Connect browser search and file drops to reference chips and editor removal operations.

Define shared callable contracts and built-in methods, register APIs, and dispatch invocations to host capabilities and agent execution. Supply method signature formatting, CLI option specialization and patch decoding.

Compile typed contracts into Ax and validation schemas, adapt CLI generation to Ax, and extract and serialize structured results. Repair invalid outputs and enforce assertions concerning patch scope, workspace contents and ignored paths.

Coordinate extension-host execution with the Node kernel, module loader and workflow runtime. Resolve workflow modules, dispatch API calls, track asynchronous work, stream serialized output, and support cancellation and replay.

Generate API declarations and TypeScript project configuration, expose editor symbols and type availability notices, and convert successful conversation turns into editable workflow skeletons with shared parameters and confirmation steps.
Render documents from template definitions with typed fields, presets and substitutions, validating template specifications and generated output formats.
Discover skill packages across workspace, configured and global roots, resolve identifier precedence, read metadata and instructions, and validate requested workspace scope.
Parse MCP manifests, register servers and typed tools, discover capabilities, execute transport operations, and manage scoped credentials.

contexts.canonicalName: Project source indexing and evidence acquisition
contexts.purpose: Parse source members and dependencies, maintain structural caches, and assemble bounded evidence from indexed workspace files and runtime or build excerpts. Supply syntax parser loading used by structural indexing and API source extraction.

Define knowledge and intent records, derive responsibility candidates from structural evidence, and generate knowledge indexes and diagram specifications. Validate ownership and reference coverage and reconcile regenerated indexes with existing knowledge.
Define and edit workspace settings and evidence budgets, coordinate initialization progress and cancellation, and persist project definitions, knowledge, architecture documents and diagram artifacts.

contexts.canonicalName: Project knowledge reader and topic navigation
contexts.purpose: Build reading topics and C4 views, assess evidence freshness, and connect project editor requests to overview pages and knowledge articles. Manage reader navigation, diagram selection, playback and Mermaid conversion.
Evaluate declared allow, deny and cycle rules against semantic diagrams. Define architecture presentation data and render rules, violations and decisions within project knowledge articles.

contexts.canonicalName: Project diagram rendering lifecycle and history
contexts.purpose: Define and validate semantic diagrams and adapter contracts, coordinate rendering engines, and maintain rendering outcomes, artifact snapshots and version comparisons. Validate viewer export and evidence requests and track cancellable diagram tasks.

Translate semantic diagrams into Archify documents, execute layout and export processes with cancellation and temporary-file cleanup, and connect embedded viewers to validated host messages and presentation controls.

Build presentation models and reusable components for live and historical conversation turns, including history HTML and Markdown exports. Keep turn sections, diff presentation, JSON formatting, duration labels, and code-copy controls consistent across these views.

Render Mermaid SVG and enhance Markdown diagram blocks for interaction prompts and project readers. Serialize rendering, configure theme and security settings, manage temporary rendering containers, and present loading, source disclosure, and per-diagram failure states.

Define project and global resource catalogs, searchable listings, definition documents, and editing-session identities shared with conversations. Coordinate resource navigation and render global resource listings, with resource icons owned alongside their document models.

Implement chat and code composition with source-to-view reference projection, insertion, paste handling, and host-mediated clipboard requests. Integrate TypeScript declarations, completions, diagnostics, and language-service configuration into workflow authoring.

contexts.canonicalName: Shared Monaco initialization and syntax theming
contexts.purpose: Provide Monaco initialization and syntax coloring shared by editable input and displayed source. Extract VS Code token styles in the host, translate them into Monaco theme rules, and apply consistent themes to editors and source highlighting.

contexts.canonicalName: Workspace context capture and reference navigation
contexts.purpose: Adapt VS Code selections, files, directories, and symbols into context snapshots and attachments. Connect selection actions and clipboard file references with navigation to workspace documents, referenced ranges, and external links.

Apply workflow patches through VS Code after checking workspace trust, file membership, ranges, expected content, and optional hashes. Submit workspace edits, save affected documents, and return unchanged, conflict, or applied results with updated document references.

Connect workspace evidence, project storage, generation services, and the project editor. Coordinate knowledge initialization, topic evidence collection, architecture and diagram generation, and reader viewing and export actions through the VS Code host.

Execute workflow shell commands with workspace-trust checks, workspace-contained working directories, validated environment overrides, and bounded timeouts. Manage process termination, capture bounded stdout and stderr, and report execution status and duration.

Implement browser forms and dialogs for structured user responses. Render Markdown prompts and selection controls, retain drafts, and manage submission, cancellation, suspension, and dialog visibility.
Own extension activation and shutdown, command and provider registration, service composition, configuration integration, and application-level coordination of execution, resources, and restoration.

Own provider configuration parsing, profile and model catalogs, persisted agent selections, and selection-default presentation for model controls. Keep profile configuration and its model-selection presentation together across host and browser boundaries.

Own API and global-resource catalog editor specializations, API reference metadata, source-derived function descriptions, resource grouping, and API list and detail presentation. Provider registration belongs to extension composition; catalog-specific providers remain part of this feature.

Own shared editor-tab identity, panel hosting and lifecycle, persisted navigation state, restoration, and HTML document framing. The HTML renderer belongs to the shared editor surface abstraction composed by extension activation.

Own conversation coordination across the VS Code host and browser, including composer integration, execution, history restoration, resource actions, patch decisions, and the host-webview message contract. Include readiness queues, pending-input notifications, composer layout, tab dragging, output navigation, and scroll diagnostics.
